In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and agents of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] clashed during a Republic '''espionage mission''' to the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] in one of the most explosive conflicts of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
